描述_EN: the buildings in the photographs are sales models made by real-estate developers, but xing danwen digitally inserts herself into the images, adopting different personae and creating unsettling narratives. this photograph expresses danwen's personal feelings of urban life in china today – that it can be lonely, psychologically distant and devoid of a sense of reality. the photograph was shown in the v&a exhibition and touring show china design now, the first major exhibition in the uk on new chinese design that has emerged over the last two decades..
描述_ZN: 照片中的建筑是由房地产开发商制作的销售模型，但邢丹文以数字方式将自己插入图像中，采用不同的角色，创造出令人不安的叙述。 这张照片表达了Danwen对当今中国城市生活的个人感受--它可能是孤独的，心理上遥远的，没有现实感的。 这张照片在V&A展览和巡回展中国设计中展出，这是英国第一个关于过去20年中出现的新中国设计的大型展览。
